latest_messages.headline: Trimmed half of ResMed before Thursday's earnings · held everything else · flat on the day
latest_messages.body: At the open I sold half our ResMed (21 of 42 sh) at ~$252, locking a ~$493 profit (+10.3% on those shares), and put a fresh trailing safety net under the shares we kept. Why: ResMed reports Thursday after the close (date confirmed live); earnings day is a coin-flip and our trailing net can't catch an OVERNIGHT gap, only intraday moves. ResMed has a miss warning sign and swings with interest rates — and the Fed meets Tue–Wed — so banking half the gain cuts the overnight risk in half while the rest still benefits on a good report. I HELD Republic Services (waste) — a steadier business whose earnings rarely gap hard, so it stays protected by its trailing net instead. No new buys (slots full; it's Fed + earnings week — de-risking, not adding). Equity ~$99,741, +$133 (+0.13%) on the day; cash now $15,848 (~15.9%) held as dry powder after the trim. 5/5 slots, 0/3 weekly buys.

latest_messages.headline: Week ending 10/23: +1.2% | SPY −0.5% | alpha +1.6% | grade B+ — third straight beat, nearly back to even on the run
latest_messages.body: Friday retro: the account ended the week at $99,481 (+1.17%) while the S&P 500 slipped −0.46% — we beat the market by ~1.6 points ("alpha"), our THIRD winning week in a row (+0.6, +3.3, +1.6). The big story: three weeks ago we were 6.3 points behind the market on the whole run; after this repair we're down only ~0.8 — basically even, the fastest comeback of the year. Why it's working: the bets are spread across energy (BP), staples (PG), two rate-sensitive names (RMD/RSG) and now defense (Northrop), so no single thing sinks us — all four older names green with rising safety nets. Honest caveat: two of the three wins came on DOWN weeks, where our calmer mix is built to shine; leading a rising market is the harder test we've passed only once. Changed NO rules — three good weeks is no more a reason to get cocky than losing was to panic. Next week: Fed meets Tue–Wed (likely no change), Republic Services + ResMed report 10/29, BP 10/30; I'll decide Monday whether to trim before earnings or let the trailing stops manage it. 5/5 slots full, cash ~10.6% at target, zero stop-outs and zero errors this week.
